title: Friedman and the Woods authenticate MJ-12 documents

tellings.quote: I tend to adhere to the work of Stanton Friedman who spent a bunch of time authenticating the uh special operations manual and Eisenhower briefing document with the woods.

plain: An online UFO researcher who goes by UAPGerb tells podcast host Jesse Michels that he follows the work of Stanton Friedman, a UFO researcher, who spent years with two other researchers, Ryan and Robert Wood, checking whether two papers were genuine. The papers are a Special Operations Manual, said to give instructions for handling crashed UFOs, and the Eisenhower briefing document, said to brief President Eisenhower on a secret UFO group called Majestic 12. If the papers are real, the US government secretly handled UFOs from the late 1940s on.
